name: io.github.yarenty/emperor-mail
title: emperor-mail
description: Email over IMAP and SMTP: search and read messages and attachments; draft and send when switched on

packageArguments.description: Speak MCP over stdin/stdout with one mailbox from the environment
Offer the draft tool (same as MAIL_WRITABLE=true); without it the server is read-only
Offer the send tool, and draft with it (same as MAIL_ALLOW_SEND=true); without it send is not offered

packageArguments.name: --send-allow
packageArguments.description: Recipients send may write to: an address (ann@example.org) or a domain (@example.org); repeatable or comma-separated (same as MAIL_SEND_ALLOW)

packageArguments.name: --from-allow
packageArguments.description: From addresses send and draft may use: an address or a domain (@example.org); repeatable or comma-separated (same as MAIL_FROM_ALLOW). Unset: any

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_USER
environmentVariables.description: Login name for IMAP and SMTP

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password or app password (set this or MAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN)

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 access token for XOAUTH2, instead of a password (Gmail, Microsoft 365)

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_FROM
environmentVariables.description: From address when the login name is not an address (default: the login name)

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_SECURITY
environmentVariables.description: IMAP connection security; plain only for a loopback host (default tls, starttls on port 143)

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SMTP server host name, needed only for send

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_SECURITY
environmentVariables.description: SMTP connection security; plain only for a loopback host (default tls, starttls on ports 587 and 25)

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: true offers the draft tool; unset, empty, false, 0, no or off keep the server read-only

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: true offers the send tool and draft; unset, empty, false, 0, no or off keep send out of the tool list

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_SEND_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated recipients send may write to: addresses (ann@example.org) or domains (@example.org). With sending on and none set, every recipient is refused

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_FROM_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated From addresses send and draft may use: addresses or domains (@example.org). Unset: any
